sources.title: GLM 5.2 - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: GLM 5.2 is a 753B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model developed by Z.ai. It builds on GLM 5 with a sparse-attention design that supports a 1M-token context window, targeting long-horizon agentic tasks, large-codebase engineering, and advanced reasoning, with native English and Chinese support.
